design.estimand: governor two-party margin relative to national House two-party margin
design.evaluation: expanding-cycle; tune through 2018; later-cycle check starts in 2020
design.target_limitation: Historical certified results proxy election-held-today support and include later campaign movement.
design.feature_cutoff: Every presidential feature uses the latest presidential result before its governor election.
design.uncertainty: The D/R log-ratio residual SD is floored at later-cycle out-of-fold error; cross-party-incumbent and local-signal-disagreement floors are used when at least five cases support them.

uncertainty_calibration.source: expanding-cycle out-of-fold residuals from 2020-2024; terminal results proxy held-today outcomes
